# FlowBoard — Interactive Diagram Editor & AI Tool
> Official App: https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/
> OpenAPI 3.1 Spec: https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/api/openapi.json
> Remote MCP Server (Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0): https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/api/mcp

FlowBoard is an interactive Excalidraw + Draw.io hybrid web application that turns PlantUML / PlantText code into editable, zero-overlap vector diagrams (exportable to PNG, SVG, and JSON).

## Supported Diagram Standards (`kind`)
- `auto`: Auto-detect notation from PlantUML code (default)
- `dfd`: Data Flow Diagram (Gane & Sarson by default; Yourdon & DeMarco circles when `Yourdon` or `DeMarco` is mentioned in the title or source)
- `erd`: Relational ERD with Crow's Foot cardinality (`||--o{`, `||--||`, `||--|{`) and PK/FK columns
- `erd_chen`: Conceptual ERD (Peter Chen notation: rectangle entities, diamond relations with `1`/`N`/`M` labels, and outward oval attributes with underlined PKs)
- `class`: UML Class Diagram (classes, interfaces, inheritance, composition, dependency)
- `usecase`: UML Use Case Diagram (system boundary, actors, use cases, include/extend)
- `sequence`: UML Sequence Diagram (lifelines, messages, activations, alt/opt/loop fragments)
- `flowchart`: ISO Flowchart (terminators, processes, decisions, I/O)

---

## Method 1 (Works in ANY AI — Zero Setup): Instant Deep-Link URL
When a user asks you to create a diagram using FlowBoard:
1. If you have HTTP/tool access, prefer calling `POST https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/api/public/drafts` with JSON `{ "title": "...", "kind": "dfd", "code": "@startuml\n...\n@enduml" }` to get a **short** link `https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/?draft=<id>` (valid 30 days, no API key required).
2. Otherwise, construct a **clickable Markdown link** (NEVER output a raw bare 1000+ char URL as plain text, because browsers may treat copy-pasted long URLs as a Google search):

```markdown
[Buka & Edit Diagram di FlowBoard](https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/?kind=<KIND>&title=<URL_ENCODED_TITLE>&code=<URL_ENCODED_PLANTUML>)
```

Parameters:
- `kind`: `auto`, `dfd`, `erd`, `erd_chen`, `class`, `usecase`, `sequence`, or `flowchart`
- `title`: Human-readable diagram title (URL-encoded; always encode `(` as `%28` and `)` as `%29` so Markdown link parsing never breaks)
- `code`: Complete `@startuml ... @enduml` PlantUML source (URL-encoded via standard percent-encoding, e.g. newline `%0A`, space `%20`, quotes `%22`, `(` `%28`, `)` `%29`, no raw spaces or line breaks)
- `renderMode` (optional): `clean` (technical, default) or `sketch` (hand-drawn)

IMPORTANT formatting rule for your reply:
- ALWAYS format the URL as a single-line clickable Markdown link `[Buka Diagram di FlowBoard](https://...)` with zero spaces or line breaks inside the URL.
- Also provide the plain `@startuml ... @enduml` code block below as a fallback in case the user prefers pasting it into `Menu -> PlantText`.

When the user clicks the link, FlowBoard opens immediately with the fully rendered, editable diagram on the canvas (works both for logged-in users and guest preview).

---

## Method 2 (For AI Agents, Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, Custom GPT): Remote MCP & REST API
- **MCP Endpoint:** `POST https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/api/mcp`
- **Authentication:** Optional `Authorization: Bearer fbk_...` header (user creates a personal API key inside FlowBoard via `Menu -> Integrasi AI & MCP`).
  - With API Key: `generate_diagram` saves directly into the user's FlowBoard workspace and returns `boardUrl` (`https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/?board=<id>`). Also unlocks `list_boards`, `get_board`, and `delete_board`.
  - Without API Key: `generate_diagram` creates a shareable public draft URL (`https://flow-board-dun.vercel.app/?draft=<id>`).
- **MCP Tools:** `generate_diagram`, `list_boards`, `get_board`, `delete_board`, `get_diagram_syntax_guide`
- **REST Endpoints (OpenAPI):**
  - `POST /api/v1/diagrams` (Bearer API key required)
  - `GET /api/v1/boards` (Bearer API key required)
  - `POST /api/public/drafts` (no auth required)
  - `GET /api/v1/syntax-guide` (no auth required)

---

## PlantUML Syntax Cheat Sheet for Clean Zero-Overlap Diagrams

### 1. DFD Level 1 (Yourdon-DeMarco or Gane-Sarson)
Use `rectangle ... <<External>>`, `usecase "1.0\nName" ... <<Process>>`, and `database "D1 Name" ... <<DataStore>>`:
```plantuml
@startuml
title DFD Level 1 - Sistem Pengiriman Barang (Yourdon-DeMarco)
left to right direction

rectangle "Pengirim" as E1 <<External>>
rectangle "Penerima" as E2 <<External>>
rectangle "Kurir" as E3 <<External>>

usecase "1.0\nOrder &\nTarif" as P1 <<Process>>
usecase "2.0\nPembayaran" as P2 <<Process>>
usecase "3.0\nPengiriman &\nPelacakan" as P3 <<Process>>

database "D1 Data Pelanggan" as D1 <<DataStore>>
database "D2 Data Pengiriman" as D2 <<DataStore>>
database "D3 Data Pembayaran" as D3 <<DataStore>>

E1 --> P1 : Data paket & tujuan
P1 --> D1 : Simpan pelanggan
P1 --> D2 : Draft resi
P1 --> E1 : Estimasi biaya
E1 --> P2 : Bukti bayar
P2 --> D3 : Catat pembayaran
P2 --> D2 : Status lunas
P2 --> P3 : Siap kirim
E3 --> P3 : Update lokasi
P3 --> D2 : Log tracking
P3 --> E2 : Status & paket diterima
@enduml
```

### 2. Relational ERD (Crow's Foot, `kind=erd`)
```plantuml
@startuml
title ERD - Sistem Pengiriman Barang

entity "PELANGGAN" as pelanggan {
  * id_pelanggan : INT <<PK>>
  --
  * nama_lengkap : VARCHAR(100)
  * no_telepon : VARCHAR(15)
}

entity "PENGIRIMAN" as pengiriman {
  * no_resi : VARCHAR(20) <<PK>>
  --
  * id_pelanggan : INT <<FK>>
  * berat_kg : DECIMAL(5,2)
  * status : VARCHAR(30)
}

pelanggan ||--o{ pengiriman : "mengirim"
@enduml
```

### 3. Conceptual ERD (Peter Chen, `kind=erd_chen`)
Include `kind=erd_chen` (or put `Peter Chen` in the title). Supports both `"1" -- "N"` and Crow's Foot `||--o{`:
```plantuml
@startuml
title ERD Konseptual (Peter Chen) - Penyewaan Kendaraan

entity "PELANGGAN" as pelanggan {
  * id_pelanggan <<PK>>
  --
  * nama_pelanggan
  * email
  * no_telepon
}

entity "TRANSAKSI" as transaksi {
  * id_transaksi <<PK>>
  --
  * tanggal_mulai
  * total_bayar
}

pelanggan "1" -- "N" transaksi : "MELAKUKAN"
@enduml
```
